description:
Add someone as a follower of a task, or remove them. ticket accepts a UUID, ticket slug, or full browser task URL (property optional when ticket is a URL). user accepts an email or a user UUID and must be a member of the task's board. Pass remove: true to drop the person from the followers instead. Adding a follower notifies them just like the app does; the call is idempotent.

Cost: 2 credits per call.

Examples:
```json
// add a teammate as a follower of the task.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","ticket":"fix-favicon-on-homepage","user":"teammate@example.com"}
```
name: add_task_follower
title: Manage task followers
